_comment: Virgil's glossary — plain-language entries for UI names and readouts. Hand-written; config, committed. Keys are lowercase snake_case and must never equal a module key (module descriptions come from their docstrings, through Daedalus). Each text: one or two sentences, ending in a period, at most 240 characters.

home.label: Felhaven
home.text: Home. Talk to Pythia here; her language model runs on this PC, not in the cloud.

chronometry.label: Chronometry
chronometry.text: Time awareness: the date, the time, the season, and where the day stands.

moderati.label: Moderati
moderati.text: The machine looking at itself: vitals, network, logs, keys, settings, and a map of its own modules.

atmospherics.label: Atmospherics
atmospherics.text: Weather for your location, now and in the days ahead, with sunrise, sunset and the moon.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.text: Charts and maps. Open it to find the Celestarium and the Cartograph.

celestarium.label: Celestarium
celestarium.text: A map of the sky overhead right now, with constellation stories and tonight's viewing conditions.

cartograph.label: Cartograph
cartograph.text: A local map: terrain, water and roads around one point, saved so it still works offline.

dynastic_vault.label: Dynastic Vault
dynastic_vault.text: Finance, behind Cerberus's lock: prices for a watchlist, and a buy and sell ledger you keep by hand.

scriptorium.label: Scriptorium
scriptorium.text: News. Headlines from the feeds you chose, each one linking back to where it came from.

vox_array.label: Vox Array
vox_array.text: Audio: music from YouTube, text turned into audio files, playback of those files, and the Auto-DJ's memory.

cogitator.label: Cogitator
cogitator.text: Small utilities: a to-do list and notes, a calculator, and a unit converter.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.text: The processor, the part that does the computing. Spikes are normal; pinned near 100% for minutes means something is working it hard.

ram.label: RAM
ram.text: Short-term working memory, where programs keep what they're using right now. Busy is fine; near 100% for a long stretch makes everything slow.

disk.label: Disk
disk.text: Long-term storage, where files stay when the PC is off. This shows how full the drive is; leave some room free for Windows and updates.

wifi.label: Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Whether this PC's Wi-Fi adapter is connected. Connected isn't the same as online; the next row says that.

internet.label: Internet
internet.text: Whether the internet actually answers. "limited" usually means a sign-in page is in the way, like hotel or campground Wi-Fi.

ollama.label: Ollama
ollama.text: The program that runs Pythia's language model on this PC. If it's offline, Pythia can't answer.
